landing.empty: No boards yet. Create one to get started.
landing.empty_mobile: No boards yet. Create one from a larger screen.

secrets.title: Board credentials
secrets.name: Name
secrets.name_hint: Upper case letters, digits and underscore only. Must start with a letter.
secrets.write_only: The value is stored encrypted and cannot be read back. To change it, replace the credential.
secrets.callback_ok: Credential authorized. You can close this tab.
secrets.callback_fail: The authorization could not be completed.
secrets.method_api_key_hint: Sent verbatim, with no prefix. This is what APIs with their own header or parameter use, such as apikey.
secrets.method_bearer_hint: Sent as "Bearer <value>". Use it in the Authorization header.
secrets.method_basic_hint: Sent as "Basic <base64 of user:password>". The backend does the base64.
secrets.no_credentials: This board has no credentials yet. Add one first.
secrets.connect_hint: You will be sent to the provider to sign in and approve access. Only tokens are stored; the application credential is the platform's.
secrets.mine_hint: Credentials you keep on this board for yourself. Nobody else on the board can see them or use them in a card; they are removed if you leave the board.
secrets.empty_mine: You have no credentials of your own on this board.

auth.name: Name
auth.check_inbox: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address and sign in.
auth.forgot_hint: We will email you a link to choose a new one. It also lets an account created with Google sign in with a password.
auth.forgot_sent: If {email} has an account, we sent it a link to choose a password. It is valid for one hour.
auth.error_email_not_verified: Confirm your email first: we sent you a link when you signed up.
auth.error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.error_weak_password: The password must have between 8 and 128 characters.
auth.error_invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
auth.error_invalid_state: This sign-in expired or was started in another browser. Try again.
auth.error_provider_error: Google could not confirm your identity. Try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.add_password_hint: You sign in with Google only. A password lets you sign in without it; we email you a link to choose one.
profile.save_failed: The name could not be saved.
profile.language_hint: Emails from the platform arrive in this language.

tokens.title: Developer access tokens
tokens.hint: Let a developer tool, such as an MCP client, read and edit your boards and cards as you. Tokens never reach your credentials or sharing, and they expire.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.create_failed: The token could not be created.
tokens.too_many: You already have the maximum number of active tokens. Revoke one first.
tokens.rate_limited: Too many tokens created recently. Try again later.
tokens.created_hint: This is the only time it is shown. Paste it into your MCP client:
tokens.revoke_confirm: Revoke "{name}"? Tools using it stop working right away.
tokens.revoke_failed: The token could not be revoked.

members.title: People on this board
members.viewer_hint: You can look at this board and its cards, but not change them.
members.error_user_not_found: Nobody is registered with that email.
members.error_rate_limited: You added too many people in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
members.error_unknown: That did not work. Try again.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.hint: Boards and groups created in an organization reach all its members: admins act as their owners, members can look at them.
orgs.none: You are not in any organization yet.
orgs.name: Organization name
orgs.delete_hint: An organization can be deleted once no board or group belongs to it.
orgs.board_in: The board will belong to {org}, so everyone in it will see it.
orgs.error_user_not_found: Nobody is registered with that email.
orgs.error_last_admin: An organization needs an admin. Make someone else an admin first.
orgs.error_org_not_empty: Delete its boards and groups first.
orgs.error_rate_limited: You added too many people in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
orgs.error_unknown: That did not work. Try again.

card_title.label: Title
card_title.variables_hint: Click one to insert it, or type {syntax}. Values are filled in when the card loads.
card_title.none: This card has no values to use in its title.

node_detail.unavailable_type: This card's type is no longer available, so it can't be edited.
node_detail.error: The card could not be loaded.
node_detail.forbidden: The credential this card uses is no longer available to you.

board.title: Board configuration
board.viewer_hint: You can look at this board and its cards, but not change it.
board.delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? All its cards and credentials are removed.

postit_templates.title: Post-it templates
postit_templates.hint_user: Only you see these, and you can use them on any board you edit.
postit_templates.hint_board: Everyone on this board sees these; its editors use and manage them.
postit_templates.hint_org: Every member of the organization sees these and can use them on its boards; its admins manage them.
postit_templates.confirm_delete: Delete "{name}"? Cards already made from it keep working but can no longer be edited.
postit_templates.read_only: You can see these but not change them.
postit_templates.name: Name
postit_templates.rate_hint: How long an answer is reused before fetching again. 0 fetches every time.
postit_templates.parameters_hint: What whoever adds the card fills in. Use the key (like {example}) in the query string or headers below. A field without a default value is required; a "credential" field lets them pick one of the board's credentials.
postit_templates.label: Label
postit_templates.request_hint: Fixed values, or a form field key such as {example}.
postit_templates.outputs_hint: Each value is picked from the response with a jq expression (like {example}). The example only previews the title.
postit_templates.err_resource: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
postit_templates.err_outputs: Add at least one value to show.
postit_templates.err_output_query: Every value needs a jq expression.
postit_templates.err_param_key: "{key}" is not a valid field key: use $ followed by lowercase letters, digits or _.
postit_templates.err_param_label: Every form field needs a label.
postit_templates.err_undeclared: {value} is not one of the form fields.
postit_templates.err_title: The title is required and may only use the values above, as {syntax}.
postit_templates.error_limit: This place already has the maximum number of templates.
postit_templates.org_elsewhere: This board is not in that organization: its templates can only be used on its own boards.
postit_templates.draft_kept: Your unsaved template is kept; switch to a tab where you can create to save it.

one_off.sidebar_hint: Drop it on the board and connect it to any API, without creating a template.
one_off.hint: This card only exists here. To reuse the same API on other cards, create a post-it template instead.
one_off.request_hint: Fixed values, or one of your credentials (it is never shown on the card).
one_off.outputs_hint: Each value is picked from the response with a jq expression (like {example}).
one_off.err_row_key: Every query string parameter and header needs a name.
one_off.err_credential: Pick a credential for every row set to use one.
one_off.error: The card could not be saved: {detail}
